integrity: One mathematical character claim, with all-parameter proof and separate finite signed-trace checks. Verification is internal to the presentation; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the rational top-degree representation of a specified reflection Klein four-group on finite linear hexagonal chains is classified. No integral representation lattice, equivariant homotopy classification, or extension to wider grids is proved. Underlying sphere-wedge type is taken from arXiv:2512.21318v1.
title: Reflection characters of linear hexagonal-chain independence complexes
